Players Committee card image of [[Jakku: Tuanul Village (Dark) (Errata)|Jakku: Tuanul Village (Dark) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “'''Light Side:''' Resistance characters are each defense value and forfeit +1 here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/jakkutuanulvillage.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c 6894629] (11 June 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
